description:
## Scope
- apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/message.ex
- apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/message_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/pending_message_queue_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/loop_behavior_test.exs

## Change
\`Message.normalize/1\` currently:
\`\`\`elixir
def normalize(str) when is_binary(str), do: %User{content: str, timestamp: ...}
def normalize(%User{} = m), do: m
def normalize(%ToolResult{} = m), do: m
\`\`\`

Becomes:
\`\`\`elixir
def normalize(str) when is_binary(str),
  do: %User{content: [%Text{text: str}], timestamp: ...}

def normalize(%User{content: c} = m) when is_binary(c),
  do: %{m | content: [%Text{text: c}]}

def normalize(%User{content: c} = m) when is_list(c), do: m

def normalize(%ToolResult{content: c} = m) when is_binary(c),
  do: %{m | content: [%Text{text: c}]}

def normalize(%ToolResult{content: c} = m) when is_list(c), do: m
\`\`\`

(Assistant.t() is unaffected — its content was always list-shape.)

## Tests
- New unit tests in message_test.exs covering each lift path.
- Existing tests that assert `assert %User{content: \"hi\"}` after
  going through normalize/prompt/steer/follow_up update their
  expectation to `[%Text{text: \"hi\"}]`. There are about 6 such
  sites in pending_message_queue_test.exs and loop_behavior_test.exs
  (the QueueUpdate snapshot tests added in opi-tze.3 land here).
- All 138 octo_pi_agent tests pass.

## Out of scope
- Type tightening on User/ToolResult — happens in opi-5ka.2 once all
  call sites are normalize-clean.
- Downstream branch removal — opi-5ka.3 onward.
title: Lift string content to %Text{} list in Message.normalize/1
